relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Under pathological conditions, CGRP signaling may be aberrantly activated and can amplify bladder inflammation.

relationships.subject: CGRP8-34
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas local application of the CGRP receptor antagonist CGRP8-34 substantially reduces the microvascular inflammatory response [34]

relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: SP released by sensory nerves activates mast cell degranulation through the SP-NK1R axis

relationships.subject: Bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Bradykinin from mast cells can also act through B1/B2 receptors on bladder afferents to enhance neuronal excitability and promote urinary frequency and pain sensitization [66]

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Through the RAMP1-CLR axis, CGRP suppresses neutrophil recruitment and MPO activity, thereby reducing bacterial clearance [59]

key_findings: Review of neuro-immune-urothelial signaling in bladder sensory neurons; CGRP and SP-NK1R are mostly preclinical candidate pathways.
TRPV1 desensitization has some support in SCI-related NDO but should not be generalized to IC/BPS.
